Hi Emily / David —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier — quick recap and my proposed next steps below.

Recap (high level):
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood to run inference for your triage & clinical summarization pipelines with predictable latency.
- Key constraints you highlighted: VPC/network isolation, KMS integration for keys, retention & audit log requirements, and model quantization tolerance for cost savings.
- Success criteria for POC: sub-100ms 8k token tail latency at production traffic, reproducible evals, and a clear mutual action plan to hand off to your infra team.

Proposed next step: infra + ops deep-dive (60 min) to cover architecture, network/firewall needs, KMS/HSM options, and POC scope. Please confirm who from your side should attend (security/network and infra strongly recommended).

Two slots we can offer (pick one):
- Wed Sep 15, 2026 — 10:00–11:00 AM ET (7:00–8:00 AM PT)
- Fri Sep 17, 2026 — 1:00–2:00 PM ET (10:00–11:00 AM PT)

Attendees we suggest from Redwood: me (AE), Karthik Iyer (Solutions Engineer).

Also: do you prefer Google Meet or Zoom for the session? I can send a calendar invite and a Meet link now if you want — otherwise I can wait for confirmation of the exact slot and final attendee list.

Attachments: redwood-infra-one-pager.pdf (short notes on deployment modes), mutual-action-plan.csv (starter MAP template).

If either slot works, I will send the invite and include an agenda and the Meet link.

Best,
